description: Safe but visibly effective professional development for an uncertain real-estate category.

exposure.instruction: Set a visibly brighter, balanced exposure when the photograph needs it; preserve already-bright areas and do not wash out the scene.

shadows.instruction: Open blocked shadows decisively enough to reveal existing detail while retaining natural depth and black separation.

highlights.instruction: Recover bright-window, reflective, and pale-surface detail from the existing pixels without inventing information.

contrast.instruction: Establish clean midtone separation after tonal recovery; keep contrast photographic and never HDR-like.

whiteBalance.instruction: Neutralize unwanted casts, then keep a refined neutral-to-slightly-warm balance appropriate to the actual light.

vibrance.instruction: Enrich muted existing color selectively while preserving realistic material response and hue separation.

saturation.instruction: Use only the saturation needed for a clearly polished result; keep neutrals neutral and avoid clipped color.

texture.instruction: Reveal existing material texture and tonal variation without inventing detail or creating a gritty finish.

clarity.instruction: Add only clean local definition needed for readability; avoid halos, crunchiness, and artificial microcontrast.

sharpness.instruction: Apply restrained final sharpening only to existing edges; no halos or synthetic detail.
